synopsis: UNECE WP.29 is the World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations, which adopts UNECE vehicle regulations; GRVA is its working party on automated, autonomous and connected vehicles [f15391, f15389]. According to dSPACE, WP.29 added virtual testing to UN R171 at the end of 2024, while independent accounts report that its 2025 supplements to UN R152 permit virtual testing instead of some physical tests for car and van AEBS [f1276, f7546, f7682]. The adopted UN R152 text dated 28 August 2025 requires physical confirmatory tests but leaves their number to agreement between the manufacturer and authority [f7684, f7549, f15401]. A claimed 30% physical-test share in a UTAC CERAM working document and vendor commentary cannot be reconciled with that adopted text; the adopted text governs [f8188]. An AVL presentation also describes WP.29's NATM credibility assessment, but the supplied precedents and requirements concern on-road regulation and do not establish an off-road approval route [f8951, f15389, f1276, f7684].
